source.title: Migrate from prompt objects | OpenAI API

claims: Reusable Prompt objects were deprecated on 2026-06-03, and v1/prompts is scheduled to shut down on 2026-11-30.
Prompt content should move out of managed Prompt objects and into application code.
Responses requests should pass generated messages directly as input instead of referencing Prompt objects.
Prompt variables should become application function arguments, and prompt versioning should move to the repository.
